storages.title: Storages — {{name}}
storages.intro: A storage is a collection of JSON objects kept in the database. It declares the object model, the functional key that recognises an object from one write to the next, and the properties objects can be filtered on. It lives without any source: it will also be written to through the API or MCP.

form.title: New storage
form.keysHelp: Tick the properties that identify an object from one write to the next. Only values can be ticked: an array or an object cannot be compared.
form.nameHelp: Storage identifier, derived from the label: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. It names the file and cannot be renamed once declared.
form.indexesHelp: Add as many indexes as you need, then choose their columns in the model tree. At most three columns per index, and their order matters: a composite index serves filters on its first column, then on its first two, and so on.

editor.savedRewrite: Storage saved. The model or the indexable properties changed: the next import will rewrite every object and its index.
editor.deleteBody: The file storages/{{name}}.yaml will be removed from the branch.

problems.nom_invalide: Name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, unique.
problems.modele_invalide: Model “{{detail}}” is not of the form scope/name.
problems.modele_inconnu: Model “{{detail}}” does not exist on this branch.
problems.cle_vide: At least one key path is required: without a key, objects cannot be reconciled.
problems.cle_doublee: The same key path is declared twice.
problems.chemin_de_propriete_attendu: “{{detail}}” must be a path of property names from $, with no array index.
problems.propriete_inconnue: “{{detail}}” designates nothing in the storage model.
problems.tableau_interdit: “{{detail}}” designates an array: a single value per object is required, otherwise the index row is no longer unique.
problems.valeur_attendue: “{{detail}}” designates an object, not a value.
problems.declaration_invalide: Unreadable declaration: the file was edited outside Miles.
problems.index_sans_colonne: Index “{{detail}}” carries no column: it would index nothing.
problems.trop_de_colonnes: Too many columns ({{detail}}): at most three per index.
problems.colonne_doublee: Column “{{detail}}” is declared twice in the same index.
